description: Post your load order — but here, not in a Discord. Reads it for a specific game from whichever manager the user runs (MO2, r2modman, or best-effort Vortex). Normalized output: each entry has name, enabled state, load-order index, and attribution when available. Read-only. Use when the user says "show/post my load order", "what mods do I have enabled", or "what order are my mods in".

gameId.description: Canonical game ID (e.g. 'skyrimspecialedition', 'lethalcompany'). Use mw_detect_environment to discover the games on this machine.

instancePath.description: Optional override for MO2's instance path — useful for portable MO2 installs that don't live under %LOCALAPPDATA%/ModOrganizer.

modManager.description: Which mod manager to read from. Default 'auto' — picks the most likely manager for this game's family.

profileName.description: Profile name. MO2 reads the active profile from ModOrganizer.ini if omitted; r2modman defaults to the first profile alphabetically (typically 'Default').

name: mw_read_load_order
